evidence.reason: The dependency regex omits StopPropagatedFrom= and PropagatesStopTo=, even though it already treats other stop-propagating directives such as PartOf= and BindsTo= as dependencies. A unit can therefore reference a crq-* unit through these systemd v257 directives without the scan rejecting it, allowing a fence stop of crq-tick.service to propagate to a co-tenant, or the reverse. Adding both directive names to DEPENDENCY_RE is the smallest compatible fix.
